mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE has exceeded 7.0% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages, or the interaction effect (via joint signal) has a Rank IC below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 100), supply chain constraints and reduced industrial activity depress corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates improving residential construction activity, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS above 6-month moving average) combined with a restrictive monetary policy stance (FEDFUNDS above 0.25%) signals an overheating economy that triggers Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS is above 6mo MA and FEDFUNDS is above 0.25%, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions (GDPC1 growth rate above 2.0% annually), demand is overheated and vulnerable to a correction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annual growth exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
